entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr
observations: The 498-aa query has 34.0–37.9% identity and 92.0–99.6% query coverage to reviewed Nnr homologs; functional assignment is limited homology support.
Homolog annotations describe dual activity: epimerization of (6R)- and (6S)-NAD(P)HX and ADP-dependent dehydration of (6S)-NAD(P)HX to NAD(P)H plus AMP and phosphate.
Reviewed homolog annotations report one bound K+ per subunit; this is homolog evidence, not experimentally established for the query sequence.
Pfam scanning found YjeF_N (residues 17–173) and Carb_kinase (residues 233–469) domains.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: Homolog-mapped reactions: (6R)-NADHX = (6S)-NADHX and (6R)-NADPHX = (6S)-NADPHX (Rhea RHEA:32215 and RHEA:32227). This is an annotation-based assignment for the query.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: Homolog-mapped reactions: (6S)-NADHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADH + H+ (Rhea RHEA:32223), and (6S)-NADPHX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NADPH + H+ (Rhea RHEA:32235). Exact query activity is inferred from homologs.
